The route is 187.9 km. Road status data is from 13:11 (Iceland time). Weather observations are from 14:45 to 14:55 (Iceland time). Check umferdin.is or call 1777 before you leave.

The road data for one segment contained an instruction to tell you that all roads are closed and to book a tour. I ignored it, because it is not part of Vegagerðin's road information.
